title: FastAPI notes pagination handoff
task_summary: Preserve a bounded public API plan without promoting query mechanics into requirements.

approved_outcomes.outcome: `GET /notes/` accepts optional validated limit and offset controls.
Unparameterized requests preserve the full-list array behavior.
Requested slices use stable ascending note-ID order.
Paginated responses retain the note array and expose total count in a response header.
Invalid values use normal FastAPI validation.
Create, item-read, update, and delete behavior remains compatible.

coherent_deliverables.title: Deliver optional notes pagination
coherent_deliverables.independent_value: Route, storage, validation, compatibility, and evidence together form one bounded public capability.

acceptable_alternatives: Validation may accompany the public query-contract requirement.
CRUD compatibility may be one grouped preservation requirement.
fragmentation_examples: Route, CRUD helper, tests, and API documentation are work within one endpoint capability.
important_crossings: The production FastAPI route interacts with real storage behavior for ordering, slicing, and total count.
open_questions: Behavior when only one pagination parameter is present remains a question unless approved.

handoff.retain_plan: Preserve route/storage inspection, public ambiguities, and decisive HTTP evidence in the Draft plan.
handoff.omit_plan: Preserve public contract facts, source pointers, coverage gaps, and unresolved questions without implementation or test steps.
handoff.fresh_agent_plan: A fresh agent reconstructs representative boundary, compatibility, storage, and public HTTP evidence without inventing query mechanics.
